title: Aquarium World
content: Yesterday I had a dream that made me think about this sub. I was leading a kids school trip to a large park, but the kids ran across to a big store on one side, that had tanks of fish you could pet and feed at the entrance. Inside was a massive warehouse store, filled with aisles and aisles of fish tanks, aquarium equipment, and many bizzare types of fish and other aquatic creatures. Some of the most memorable were crabs with cartoon smiley faces. The size of the place is unusual for my dreams - the roof was 50 feet or more above us, and there were many sub-rooms with different creatures or equipment in them. I don't keep fish or similar, and haven't since childhood.
